summary: Fourteen OpenNeuro subjects at 1.5 T, 3 T and 7 T from Siemens, GE and Philips scanners: single-band, multiband (4 and 8), multi-echo and sparse BOLD, every kind of field map, MPRAGE, MP2RAGE, T2w and FLAIR anatomy, two children, four older adults, a brain tumour and a stroke with its manual lesion mask, strong head motion and low quality.

criteria.label: Sparse acquisition (TR far above the acquisition)
Field map not linked to the BOLD
An fMRIPrep 25.2.6 oracle run (done or planned)

datasets.scanner: Siemens 3 T (the study's; the files do not record it)
datasets.role: fMRIPrep's own test subject: single-band BOLD without slice timing or a field map, 4 mm slices; every tool's reference case.

anat.defacing: defaced: the face's voxels set to 0 (OpenfMRI's defacing); no nose, mouth or eyes in the slices or on the surface
34 axial slices of 4 mm that end above the eyes: no face in the field of view
